name: so101_reach_vision_mujoco_v0
description: SO-101 MuJoCo reach benchmark for low-resolution wrist-camera pixel RL.
notes: Vision training is opt-in via the pixel actor-critic seed; existing state-based SO-101 reach benchmarks are unchanged.
Reach success mirrors the SO101-Nexus ReachConfig default success_threshold=0.02 m, with targets sampled from a 0.15 m half-extent 3D workspace around the task center.
Episode horizon is 150 control steps so folded-start/camera-search policies have time to acquire and reach edge/corner fixed eval targets.
The policy input feed is the low-resolution wrist camera plus proprioception. The world feed is debug-only and appears in synchronized sampled trajectory artifacts.
